name: perf_crash_cub_tree100
what: ROW 14: the cub off HOME, ~5 m up, its wing into a tree (r 0.35 m, 2.5 m aside: the inner wing) 60 m ahead - DEFORM's tree100 stills case (the wing folds round the trunk), as the player flies it

steps.name: the trunk
steps.js: (() => { const P = window.FLIGHT_PROBE, sim = P.sim(), W = P.world(), n = sim.n, p = sim.p, v = sim.v; let cx = 0, cz = 0, vx = 0, vz = 0; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { cx += p[i*3]; cz += p[i*3+2]; vx += v[i*3]; vz += v[i*3+2]; } cx /= n; cz /= n; const h = Math.hypot(vx, vz) || 1, fx = vx / h, fz = vz / h, D = 60, off = 2.5, R = 0.35, H = 25; const tx = cx + fx * D - fz * off, tz = cz + fz * D + fx * off, g = W.terrainH(tx, tz); W.treeHits.set('fill:fs_trunk', [tx, tz, g, R, g + H]); const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(R, R + 0.05, H, 20), new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x5b4632, roughness: 0.95 })); m.position.set(tx, g + H / 2, tz); m.castShadow = true; P.craft().parent.add(m); return 'trunk ' + D + ' m ahead, ' + off + ' m aside, r ' + R + ', ' + H + ' m tall, at ' + tx.toFixed(1) + ' ' + tz.toFixed(1); })()
